long_biography.plain_text:
Education began as a field of study for Tinamarie Lavan at Rutgers and Rowan. Her training later informed community advocacy in Moorestown, where voters chose her for the local board of education. After leaving that public role, she joined the faculty of Our Lady of Good Counsel School.

A separate strand of her work took her on camera as host of College Campus Cooking. Episodes brought university students together with professional chefs to make straightforward dishes and discuss nutrition. The first instalments were filmed at Delaware Valley University and aired on NBC10 and other networks.
